visual.description: Light silver-grey used as the primary page background across all sections.
Bold red used as the dominant hero and section background color, central to the brand identity.
White used for modal/popup surfaces and form backgrounds.
Bright red used for primary CTA buttons like Submit and Discover.
Deep red used for large typographic display text and brand wordmark throughout the page.
Near-black used for large section headings and display typography on light backgrounds.
Black used for body copy, nav links, product labels, and general text.
Dark grey used for secondary or subdued text elements.
White/light grey nav background in the scrolled/opaque state.
Black text for navigation links in the scrolled opaque nav state.
Red used for the brand wordmark in the nav bar.
Silver-grey nav background visible in the scrolled state matching page background.
Black nav link text in the scrolled state.
Light grey used for borders on input fields and form elements.
Black border used on modal containers and form input outlines.
Mustard yellow used as a section background accent for the Salad Dressing category.
Deep green used as a section background for the Macaroni & Cheese category.
Vivid blue used as a section background for the Seasoning product category.
